question.text: A CIV scheme (Co-Investment Vehicle) under SEBI (AIF) Regulations can be offered to accredited investors of a particular scheme of which category/categories of AIFs?

answer.text: Category I and Category II AIFs only (excluding Angel Funds)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 113, a CIV scheme is a scheme of a Category I or Category II AIF; per page 312, co-investment through a CIV scheme can be offered only to accredited investors of a particular scheme of a Category I or Category II AIF. Angel Funds cannot launch CIV schemes. The Trap: Option B is wrong because Category III AIFs are not eligible to launch CIV schemes. Option C over-generalises by including Category III. Option D is wrong because Angel Funds, although a sub-set of Category I Venture Capital Funds, are excluded from launching CIV schemes. Note: The CIV route is restricted to accredited investors of a particular scheme of a Category I or Category II AIF; it is not open to all investors of the scheme.
